case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.correct_value: Four charge-sheeted; three convicted at trial
number_of_accused.quote: a charge sheet was filed against four accused
number_of_accused.reason: Three were convicted, but the charge sheet named four accused, including the acquitted brother-in-law.

accused_gender.reason: Accused include male (husband, father-in-law) and female (mother-in-law) persons.

accused_age.reason: No ages of the accused are stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Businessman/shopkeeper (Jamnadas); appellants worked in their shop
accused_occupation.quote: appellant Jamnadas is a businessman having his shop
accused_occupation.reason: Businessman is stated only for Jamnadas; the shop is described for the appellants generally.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is a young bride, referred to as female throughout.

victim_age.reason: Victim's age is not stated, only that she was a young bride.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Relationships are in-laws and spouse; 'Relative' and 'Family' are loose descriptors not stated as such.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charges under ss.302/34, 201, 304-B and 498-A are all listed in the judgment.

weapon.correct_value: Knives and scissors (hard and sharp object)
weapon.quote: examination made on 25-09-2006 of weapons (knives and scissors)
weapon.reason: The judgment expressly refers to knives and scissors as weapons examined, not 'none mentioned'.

evidence_type.quote: PW 1 to PW 5 ... saw ... throwing the dead body in the park
evidence_type.reason: No dying declaration appears; eyewitness testimony of PW 1 to PW 5 is omitted.

confession.reason: No confession by any accused is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Body cutting, blood stains, false explanation and multiple perpetrators are all supported by the chain of circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: The judgment identifies no mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted three accused under s.302/34 and acquitted brother-in-law Vishal.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeals, affirming the conviction.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeals; appellants stand convicted.

offence_finally_established.reason: Murder with common intention under s.302 read with s.34 is held established.

imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence of imprisonment for life under s.302/34 is stated.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life imprisonment has no fixed years, so null is consistent with the judgment.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs.5,000 each for s.302/34 convicts (default one year RI); Rs.5,000 for Dhanwantari under s.201
fine_rs.reason: The judgment states a fine of Rs.5000 was imposed, so null is contradicted.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts only: accused lived with deceased; body cut and thrown in park; blood stains found; defence version of missing bride
neutral_facts.quote: The prosecution established a complete chain of circumstances linking the accused to the crime.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the court's outcome by stating the chain was complete and the defence claim was proven false.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment imposed under s.302/34; statutory range not stated
offence_severity.quote: sentenced each of the convicts under Section 302/34 IPC imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: Minimum and maximum penalties are not stated in the judgment; 'Maximum: life' is also inconsistent with s.302.

attempt_completion.reason: The murder was completed; the deceased's death is established as homicidal.

physical_harm.reason: Autopsy describes numerous ante-mortem and post-mortem injuries and death by shock and haemorrhage.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Convictions under s.302/34 (three accused) and s.201 (Dhanwantari only); ss.304-B and 498-A ended in acquittal
number_of_offences.quote: On other heads, the accused stood acquitted from the charge.
number_of_offences.reason: Only s.302/34 and s.201 led to convictions; the other heads ended in acquittal, and s.201 applied only to Dhanwantari.

financial_property_loss.reason: The judgment does not address property or financial loss; 'Not applicable' is an unstated characterisation.

premeditation_planning.quote: had common intention with Dhanwantari in commission of brutal murder
premeditation_planning.reason: The court found common intention only; premeditation or planning is never found or discussed.

motive.reason: No motive for the murder is identified in the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accepted evidence includes the murder in the house, body cutting, blood stains, and the false s.313 explanation.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court relied on PW 1 to PW 5 and medical evidence; no express credibility assessment; PW 32 declared hostile
witness_credibility.quote: This witness was declared hostile as she did not fully support the prosecution case
witness_credibility.reason: The judgment does not expressly assess credibility of the main witnesses; it notes PW 32 was hostile, which the value omits.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: No report lodged to police about the homicidal death; false explanation given under s.313 CrPC
post_offence_conduct.quote: There is no report lodged to police by the appellants regarding homicidal death of the deceased
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment treats the failure to report and the false s.313 explanation as post-offence conduct, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not stated; only arrest dates are given.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 16.09.2006; trial conviction date not stated (sentence order 24.8.2009); HC 23.08.2012; SC 29.06.2016
trial_duration.quote: vide his order dated 24.8.2009, sentenced each of the convicts
trial_duration.reason: 24.8.2009 is the sentencing order date, not the trial judgment date; other dates are correct.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellants and State match the listing in the judgment.

investigation_status.reason: Charge sheet against four accused was filed and trial completed.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Defence alleged illegal detention for 3 days without formal arrest; court did not address it
procedural_irregularity.quote: the police illegally detained them for 3 days without formally arresting them
procedural_irregularity.reason: The defence raised an alleged illegal detention; 'None noted' omits this claim.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court convicted; High Court affirmed; SLP of Dhanwantari withdrawn; SC dismissed remaining appeals
appeal_history.quote: Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 9812 of 2013 filed by Dhanwantari ... was dismissed by this Court as withdrawn
appeal_history.reason: The trial_court entry wrongly says the High Court affirmed; the trial court convicted and the SLP was withdrawn.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State relied on Suresh v. State of Haryana on burden under s.106; chain-complete reasoning is largely the court's own
prosecution_argument.quote: learned counsel for the State of Madhya Pradesh has referred to the case of Suresh
prosecution_argument.reason: Explicit prosecution submissions are limited to citing Suresh; the rest is the court's reasoning presented as argument.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence claimed deceased went to relative's place and went missing; appellants were in shop; alibi via DW 1
defence_argument.quote: Bhoomi @ Richa was missing after she went to her relative's place
defence_argument.reason: The final sentence inverts the defence claim; the defence said she was missing, not that she was not missing.

legal_principle_applied.reason: The five Sharad Sarda circumstantial evidence principles are correctly summarised.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda; Trimukh Maroti Kirkan; Suresh; Kuldeep Singh; Rumi Bora Dutta; Mir Mohammad Omar and Narendra Singh (referred)
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Ku/deep Singlt and-otlters v. State of Rajastlian
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Omits Kuldeep Singh and Rumi Bora Dutta, which the judgment relies on for the false-explanation link.

sentencing_rationale.reason: The judgment gives no sentencing reasoning; it addresses guilt and affirms the sentence without explaining it.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The judgment identifies no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Brutal nature of the murder noted by the court
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: re-appreciated the entire evidence on record, we concur ... brutal murder of Bhoomi @ Richa
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court describes the murder as brutal, so 'None' overlooks that characterisation.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Fine Rs.5,000 with default one year RI for s.302/34 convicts; Dhanwantari 3 years RI and Rs.5,000 fine for s.201
other_sentence_order.quote: Convict Dhanvantari was further sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of three years
other_sentence_order.reason: The judgment records fines, default terms, and a 3-year sentence for Dhanwantari under s.201.
